question: Does writing the cell in analytically (SC-INR, and its footprint-exact linear-readout variant) match data augmentation where augmentation covers (asymmetric scales within the training range) and exceed it where augmentation cannot cover (downscaling, cross-scale consistency), and what does exactness cost at standard symmetric scales?
recipe: configs/train-div2k/train-liif-edsr-200ep.yaml: DIV2K, EDSR-baseline, 48x48 LR crops, 2304 queries, scales U(1,4) per axis, 200 epochs, Adam 1e-4, milestones 100/150, seeds 1 and 2; epoch-200 checkpoint regardless of validation

arms.sc-inr-200ep: SC-INR (signed omega, feature phase, analytic sinc) under the matched recipe
arms.sc-inr-nosinc-200ep: SC-INR without the sinc response: the mechanism ablation that was never trained
arms.liif-asym-200ep: LIIF trained with independent s_y, s_x ~ U(1,4): the data-augmentation control
arms.sc-inr-exact-200ep: footprint-exact local Fourier field with linear readout (src/models/sc_inr_exact.py)
arms.lte-linear-200ep: LTE with a linear readout: what the post-basis MLP contributes at symmetric scales

evaluation.standard: tools/benchmark.py: Set5/Set14/BSD100/Urban100 x2/3/4/6/8/12 (Y-PSNR, shave = scale) and DIV2K validation (RGB, shave scale+6)
evaluation.footprint: studies/footprint/01-inference/run.py over all arms via freeze.py --checkpoints, scored with --primary sc-inr-exact and again with --primary sc-inr

predictions_frozen_before_training.T1_exactness: sc-inr-exact: consistency PSNR (box of x4 output vs x2 output) exceeds 80 dB on every image; every other arm stays below 60 dB.
predictions_frozen_before_training.T2_augmentation_parity: Eight in-support asymmetric pairs, native cell: sc-inr-exact balanced PSNR-Y is within 0.05 dB of liif-asym (two-sided 95% interval of the difference inside [-0.05, +inf)). Prior: analytic footprint matches augmentation where augmentation covers.
predictions_frozen_before_training.T3_beyond_coverage: Downscale (x0.5) PSNR against the box reference: sc-inr-exact exceeds liif-asym and lte-asym with corrected lower bounds > 0 (alpha 0.05/4 one-sided). Augmentation never saw c > 1.
predictions_frozen_before_training.T4_cost_of_exactness: Standard symmetric x2/3/4 balanced Y-PSNR over the four benchmarks: sc-inr-exact is within 0.10 dB of lte-200ep. Prior uncertain; a failure is reported as the price of exactness and bounded by lte-linear.
predictions_frozen_before_training.T5_mechanism: sc-inr-nosinc: native-minus-swap on the eight in-support pairs has |point| < 0.02 dB and its 95% interval covers zero, while sc-inr-200ep's is positive with corrected lower bound > 0.

interpretations.A: T1-T3 pass: the analytic footprint is as good as augmentation inside its coverage and the only well-defined option outside it; the method paper's main claim holds.
interpretations.B: T2 fails with sc-inr-exact clearly below liif-asym: augmentation extracts asymmetric information the fixed sinc cannot; report and restrict the claim to coverage-free settings.
interpretations.C: T4 fails by more than lte-linear's own loss: exactness costs expressivity beyond the readout; report the trade-off and keep sc-inr-200ep as the practical variant.

compute: seven new arms x two seeds x about 17 GPU-hours (sc-inr-exact may be slower); benchmark and footprint inference add a few GPU-hours; no other training.
